decisions.reason: As a software product close to the core offer and well aligned with the firm's shift toward connected, data-driven infrastructure management, it is a relatively low-cost option to retain and by 2022 its continued presence suggests enough traction to keep supporting it.

This newer automation and system software also fits the firm's strategic direction and installed-base business, so management would likely keep the option open, though its shorter market history leaves somewhat more uncertainty than for A.
